# btpservice_ctms_transport_request_logs_url (Data Source)

Reads the CTMS UI link to transport request logs; it does not retrieve log contents.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "btpservice_ctms_transport_request_logs_url" "example" {
  transport_request_id = "12345"
  node_id              = "67890"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `transport_request_id` (String) Transport request identifier. This endpoint accepts a string.

### Optional

- `node_id` (String) Optional node identifier to link to the import queue logs view. This endpoint accepts a string.

### Read-Only

- `url` (String) URL returned by CTMS.
